note: Findings that belong to no single domain. Coordinator-authored from census, probes and the 30 domain sidecars.

findings.title: No architectural ratchet: nothing stops new bypasses, patches or dead modules while cleanup proceeds
findings.observed: CI runs syntax checks, the rolling test suite and three targeted guards. There is no repository-wide check for direct document writes, chat bypasses, settings reads in engines, monkey-patches, engine-to-UI imports or new unreachable modules. Existing targeted checkers (e.g. the follower mutation checker) cover a handful of files and some are not in CI.
findings.intendedOwnership: A-P3 (PROPOSED): census and invariant probes as a CI gate.
findings.proposedSolution: Add build-census.mjs --check and probe-invariants.mjs to CI as a non-blocking report, then convert to a ratchet: fail only when a probe count rises above a committed baseline. Extend P-A05 to cover createChatMessage helpers and P-A09 to the full monkey-patch pattern set found in B-PAT.
findings.alternatives: Per-domain guard tests (already the pattern for combat authority); slower to reach full coverage.
findings.regressionTests: The gate itself; verify it flags a seeded violation in a throwaway branch.
findings.simplificationBenefit: Prevents regrowth during waves 2-5; makes every later cleanup measurable.

findings.title: All 31 code-bearing domains form one dependency cycle; no domain can be tested or reasoned about in isolation
findings.observed: Domain-level strongly connected component of size 31 (domainCycles). 9 file-level static cycles (52 files), the largest coupling actor derived calculators with combat math (B-ACT F-ACT-001). Several cycles are closed by unused or re-export imports (B-PRG, B-EQP).
findings.proposedSolution: First remove the cheap cycle-closers identified in domain findings (unused imports, re-exports, dead writers). Then adopt A-P1 layers and track upward edges in dependency-matrix.md as a ratchet. Do not restructure beyond that until waves 2-4 have reduced the graph.
findings.alternatives: Accept the SCC and document allowed peer edges per domain; lower effort, keeps coupling.
findings.regressionTests: Full rolling suite; import-graph diff showing removed edges.
findings.foundryAcceptance: Smoke load of a world (no import errors).
findings.simplificationBenefit: Enables isolated testing and safe deletion; reduces load-order hazards.
findings.risk: Medium; module-evaluation order changes can surface init bugs.

findings.title: Constitutional architecture documents are stale or contradict each other (CR-01..CR-09)
findings.observed: Wrong ActorEngine path, six missing referenced documents, rules-authority model that contradicts ENGINE-ARCHITECTURE and the code, ActorEngine described as calculation-free while it orchestrates damage/condition/Force points, a 'no runtime patching' claim contradicted by 108 live patch sites, HouseRuleService method names that do not exist (B-HRL).
findings.proposedSolution: Owner rules on CR-03/CR-04 (rules-authority and ActorEngine role). Then correct the documents to reference Level A IDs instead of restating rules, and mark corrected sections with the decision date.
findings.alternatives: Freeze ARCHITECTURE.md as historical and make A-global-invariants.md the constitution.
findings.simplificationBenefit: Stops contributors (human or AI) following rules that are no longer true.

findings.title: Owner standing instructions are not committed; several APPROVED invariants have no versioned source
findings.observed: A-02 (owner-item helpers), A-10 (TransactionEngine atomicity), A-14 (unified shell, Holopad-first), A-15, A-16, A-17, A-18 rest on owner instructions given to Claude that are not in the repository.
findings.intendedOwnership: Owner decisions recorded durably (CLAUDE.md §9 authorization boundary).
findings.proposedSolution: Commit the standing instructions as a section of CLAUDE.md (owner action).

findings.title: 31 rules questions surfaced by the audit are not yet in the rules decision register (90 total; 59 already referenced)
findings.observed: Domain contracts record 90 DEFERRED_RULES_REVIEW items or rules-question findings; 59 cite an existing register ID, 31 do not. Investigators were not permitted to edit the register, and Phases 0-2 do not modify existing documents. The register is append-only and partly machine-parsed (tools/lib).
findings.proposedSolution: Review docs/audits/architecture-census/rules-questions-for-register.md and append the new items to the register (owner, or Claude on instruction). Nothing is decided by the audit.
findings.alternatives: Leave them in the audit ledger only (not recommended: CLAUDE.md requires one consolidated register).
findings.simplificationBenefit: One place for every open ruling.

findings.title: Committed scratch scripts under tests/
findings.observed: Three _scratch*.mjs files are tracked in tests/. They are not test suites (CI runs only *.test.mjs) and nothing imports them.
findings.intendedOwnership: tests/ holds suites, helpers and fixtures.
findings.proposedSolution: Delete after the owner confirms they hold nothing needed.
findings.alternatives: Move to a gitignored scratch location.

findings.title: 1.98 MB of unreferenced assets, 43 unreferenced templates and 67 unreferenced stylesheets
findings.observed: 139 assets with no reference in any runtime file, template, style, data or pack; 43 .hbs and 67 .css with no runtime reference (B-UIS sampled and classified the templates/styles). Dynamic path construction was checked through template-literal patterns; generic loaders do not cover assets.
findings.intendedOwnership: Assets owned by their referencing domain; unreferenced assets removed (OSI asset cleanup rules).
findings.proposedSolution: Apply the OSI asset checklist per file (exact path, filename, CSS url, HBS src, JS construction, packs, system.json) before deleting; delete in one batch per directory.
findings.alternatives: Move to a design archive outside the shipped package.
findings.regressionTests: validate-partials; template preload check; visual smoke.
findings.foundryAcceptance: Visual smoke of sheets and Holopad surfaces.
